description: PD-mode domain 0x50 version 3 (sparse, 32 slots, D-F14) golden vectors for firmware and Charybdis Ark. Payload: header [3, 32, 128, n, 0, 0, 0, 0], then n 128-byte records in strictly ascending slot ID. A record is version 2's 96 bytes with the name moved to the shared counted rule: byte 8 is its length (0..32), bytes 9..31 are zero, and its UTF-8 is at bytes 96..127, zero after it. A slot is stored exactly when it is configured or disabled with a name; an omitted slot is disabled with an empty name. Slot objects use pd_mode_domain_v1.json's vocabulary. Error codes are the firmware's NOAH_PROFILE_PD_V1_* names; offsets are payload-relative. Test evidence, never a migration source.

valid.name: empty
valid.description: No slot stored: all 32 disabled with empty names.

valid.name: presets
valid.description: The six presets of pd_mode_domain_v1.json plus the authored horizontal Undo / Redo in slot 6: the firmware's compiled PD domain. Slot 7 (disabled, no name) and slots 8..31 are omitted.

valid.name: gap
valid.description: Stored IDs need not be contiguous; a disabled slot with a name is stored.

valid.name: full
valid.description: Every slot stored: the largest payload, 4,104 bytes.

valid.name: longest-name
valid.description: Slot 0 named with exactly 32 bytes of UTF-8, multibyte characters included.

invalid.name: disabled-nameless-record
invalid.description: A present record that is disabled with an empty name is noncanonical: such a slot is omitted.

invalid.name: unordered-ids
invalid.description: IDs must strictly ascend.

invalid.name: duplicate-id
invalid.description: An ID may appear once.

invalid.name: id-out-of-range
invalid.description: IDs are below 32.

invalid.name: count-exceeds-records
invalid.description: Length must be 8 + 128 x the record count.

invalid.name: trailing-record
invalid.description: A record beyond the count makes the length wrong.

invalid.name: truncated
invalid.description: A truncated record makes the length wrong.

invalid.name: count-over-capacity
invalid.description: At most 32 records.

invalid.name: wrong-capacity
invalid.description: Header byte 1 is the slot capacity, 32.

invalid.name: wrong-record-size
invalid.description: Header byte 2 is the record size, 128; version 2's 96 is not read.

invalid.name: version-2-payload
invalid.description: The retired version 2 is not a version-3 payload.

invalid.description: Header bytes 4..7 are zero.

invalid.description: Reserved record bytes stay zero.

invalid.name: reserved-old-name-byte
invalid.description: Bytes 9..31, version 2's name field, are zero.

invalid.description: A name holds at most 32 bytes.

invalid.description: A name is well-formed UTF-8.

invalid.name: name-control-character
invalid.description: A name holds no control characters.

invalid.name: name-padding
invalid.description: The bytes after a name's length are zero.

invalid.name: name-cut-sequence
invalid.description: The length may not cut a UTF-8 sequence.
